name: Cvent
description: Cvent is a meetings, events and hospitality technology platform spanning event management, registration, marketing, mobile experiences, virtual and hybrid delivery, onsite operations, surveys, analytics and venue sourcing. Organizations use it to plan and operate complex event programs from invitation through reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Cvent REST API client with exactly event/events:read and select the matching US or EMEA origin, then let agents list bounded event summaries or inspect one exact event without attendee or registration data.

credentialRequirements.name: CVENT_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Cvent API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a customer-owned Cvent REST API client with only event/events:read.

credentialRequirements.name: CVENT_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Cvent region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select US or EMEA to pin the matching documented API origin.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Cvent event summaries and inspect one exact event under event/events:read.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Cvent event summaries from one page.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact Cvent event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people data
blocked.description: Contacts, attendees, registrations, admission items, speakers, exhibitors, travel, payments, surveys and custom fields are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Event, contact, attendee, session, webhook, registration and hospitality writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API
blocked.description: Arbitrary resources, filters, continuation tokens, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event metadata reads run directly; people, registration, payments, writes, bulk and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; client ownership, exact scope, region pinning, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Cvent event reads and exchanges the encrypted customer client only at its fixed regional token endpoint.
Relay mounts two typed Cvent event reads and exchanges the encrypted customer client only at its fixed regional token endpoint.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Cvent REST API client with event/events:read, a client secret and the correct US or EMEA region are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, create the customer API client with only event/events:read, select its documented region, store the secret encrypted, validate token issuance and both reads, revoke the client provider-side on disconnect, and confirm post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Cvent documents its Platform REST API, OAuth 2.0 client credentials, regional API hosts and short-lived bearer tokens.
Cvent's reference documents event/events:read and bounded event list and exact event resources under /ea/events.
